representativeSnapshot.kind: fresh and legacy-data Supabase snapshots containing tours, events_v2, and collaborators

rowCountQueries: Count tours, events_v2 rows, tour_events links, and active tour collaborators by organization
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Only newly requested quick-start drafts and explicit invitation records are created; existing rows are not rewritten

execution.resumeStrategy: Re-run the guarded DDL and idempotent function definitions, then reconcile quick-start batch keys
execution.idempotency: Schema objects, indexes, policies, and function definitions are deterministic; quick-start events use a stable batch and ordinal key

quarantine.strategy: Reject unresolved organization, tour, event, or invitation actors rather than infer tenant ownership

constraints: tour collaboration invitation lifecycle checks and foreign keys
indexes: pending invitation lookups by tour and invited user
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify function actor binding, duplicate replay, expiration, and Org A versus Org B RLS for tours, events, links, teams, vendors, and artists

recovery.rollback: Disable quick-start and collaboration entry points, retain created drafts for audit, and apply a reviewed additive policy correction
recovery.forwardFix: Apply additive function or policy repairs and reconcile stable quick-start batch keys before re-enabling

queries: Reconcile quick-start batch keys, invitation states, RLS policies, grants, and cross-organization access attempts
